sourceVersionNote: Current in-progress DOCX used to extract test paragraphs differed from revision_v2 snapshot; hash above binds the extracted content. Baseline test reproduced the exact visible defect.
findings: Both inline and display ceiling signs were slanted and visually ambiguous in actual page27 PNG.
Extracted PDF text still returned U+2308 and U+2309; text-only validation would miss this visual defect.
DOCX encoded the correct ceiling Unicode characters in m:r, with m:sty=p, Times New Roman run fonts, and no m:nor flag.
Five isolated test variants were rendered with the local LibreOffice and every page was actually opened using view_image.

minimalFix: Add m:nor m:val=1 to m:rPr for runs whose entire m:t value is U+2308 or U+2309 after mathematical styling. Existing glyph text, m:sty=p, and w:i=0 remain unchanged.
builderIntegration: In mathematical_style token loop, include token in {ceil-left,ceil-right} in the condition that adds m:nor=1; alternatively call the supplied pure helper after mathematical_style.
limitations: Test verified local LibreOffice behavior only; no claim about every Office installation or a corrected final manuscript.
No main manuscript DOCX or primary builder was modified by this reviewer.
